record.title: Tsagaannuur–Tashanta November 2020 freight closure window and petroleum exception
record.start_precision: Exact order start, enforcement not observed
record.end_precision: Schedule end; actual general freight return unknown
record.direction: Paired road crossing; later reported fuel imports into Mongolia
record.movement: Road freight, with petroleum-only periodic exception
record.exceptions: Later petroleum-only access was described for the second and fourth weeks, including same-day return of empty trucks. The reported 23 November fuel entry and scheduled 24 November restart do not establish a general freight reopening.
record.imposing_authority: Mongolian authorities and bilateral border representatives
record.enforcement: Rosgranstroy states the closure agreement and dates; the indexed NARTAM freight passage matches the named post. PKF relays a later oil-only movement account.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: EA004 concerns a passenger admission regime. This parent addresses a separately dated freight-specific local window; other Mongolian posts, Borshoo holidays and Altanbulag dates are excluded. No matching Tsagaannuur freight phase in the current/pending union.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_timing: Ordered window: dated evidence; numeric duration withheld; see qualification
record.current_corrections: The primary notice supplies a 2–23 November 2020 ordered window. Its final-day boundary is not an observed reopening. Indexed NARTAM schedules oil-only access from 24 November, while an undated attributed report places fuel trucks on 23 November. Neither establishes general freight return; petroleum access is periodic and limited. Duration is withheld rather than treating a schedule as continuous operational closure.
